Name: New Crops - Lollipops
Author: lunightmare
Description:
This mod adds two new crops to the game.
One is a giant Lollipop, the other one is a plant of tiny ones.
Hope you like it!!

PS: Planning to make more candy crops, probably I'll make a full candy bundle. So any candy requests will be welcome!


[size=5][i][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b]

[/i][/size][b][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]
[/b]

I'll probably be upaditng, so any requests will be read and answered

[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
